assets.scene: Scene/backdrop: flooded reed delta maintenance island. The huge continuous reclaimed stone and concrete dry court fills the playable center. Teal canals and dense reed wetlands occur only along the far outer perimeter. Small solar water pumps and patched modern Dutch boathouses are attached to the very outer edges. Warm hopeful sunset atmosphere, teal and gold palette, weathered adaptation infrastructure.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: painted environment background for an original Dutch action RPG, Gouden Horizon.
Output: landscape 1536x1024 image, full frame edge to edge.
Style/medium: premium nonpixel hand-painted 2.5D isometric action RPG ground view. Original environment, directional inspiration from Torchlight and Nine Parchments: slightly stylized architectural shapes, sophisticated painterly materials, crisp clearly legible gameplay floor, weathered modern post-apocalyptic Netherlands with climate adaptation technology. High oblique isometric camera looking down across the ground, no horizon or sky strip.
Composition is gameplay-critical: a broad continuous DRY unobstructed walkable stone/concrete central court occupies the rectangle from normalized x=0.18 to x=0.88 and y=0.22 to y=0.78. This rectangle must be all connected floor, with no water, pits, buildings, machines, planters, trees, rubble piles, or protruding scenery inside it. All scenery and water are confined to the outer perimeter. The floor may have restrained worn paving joints, subtle stains, small cracks and gentle painterly texture. Keep the open action area bright, clear and visually calm.
The exact floor points normalized (0.30,0.39), (0.69,0.61) and (0.80,0.27), and wide direct paths connecting them, must be unobstructed dry flat paving. Do not draw markers at these points. At x=0.80 y=0.27 there must still be flat floor, not a perimeter machine. Design the court wider than a conventional courtyard.
Lighting: warm light from the northwest/upper left, soft coherent shadows confined mainly to edges, central ground bright and easy to read.
Constraints: no UI, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no characters, no enemies, no loose items, no chests, no portals. No scenic structures intruding into the central floor.

assets.scene: Scene/backdrop: an arid former solar farm maintenance plaza. The huge continuous flat dusty orange stone court fills the playable center. Broken heliostat mirror arrays, brass cooling pipes, and low service structures occur only around the far outer edges. Heat haze in the distant perimeter. Terracotta, brass and blue palette, warm northwest sunlight with legible floor.

assets.scene: Scene/backdrop: offshore Dutch sea wall maintenance court. The huge continuous dry bluegrey stone maintenance plaza fills the playable center. Storm seawater is beyond the far outer perimeter only. Ruined wind turbines, heavy cables and harbor cranes occur only at the very outer edges; cables must not cross the playable floor. Dramatic warm gold light from upper left breaks through cool storm clouds out of frame. Bright readable central floor with warm highlights, deep bluegrey water at edges.
